chapters.title: Being Neighborly — Louisa May Alcott
chapters.notes: Study the importance of kindness, helpfulness and good relationships with neighbours. Revise the main events, character traits, theme and the lesson conveyed by the prose.

chapters.title: On to the Summit: We Reach the Top — Tenzing Norgay
chapters.notes: Focus on determination, teamwork, courage and preparation. Revise the sequence of events, challenges faced during the expedition and the qualities required to achieve a difficult goal.

chapters.title: The Call of the Soil — Venkat Iyer
chapters.notes: Study the writer’s connection with farming and the soil, sustainable agriculture and respect for nature. Note the reasons behind the writer’s choices and the central message.

chapters.title: Pillars of Democracy — Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar
chapters.notes: Revise the meaning and foundations of democracy, equality, liberty, fraternity and justice. Understand why constitutional values and responsible citizenship are essential.

chapters.title: Mrs. Adis — Sheila Kaye-Smith
chapters.notes: Read the lesson carefully and prepare a summary, character sketch of Mrs. Adis, important incidents and the central idea. Support answers with details from the text.

chapters.title: Tiger Hills — General Ved Prakash Malik
chapters.notes: Study the Kargil conflict as presented in the lesson, the role of soldiers, leadership, courage and national responsibility. Revise the important events and the author’s perspective.

chapters.title: Cherry Tree — Ruskin Bond
chapters.notes: Prepare the poem’s central idea, growth and renewal imagery, nature theme and poetic devices. For appreciation, identify the title, poet, rhyme scheme, figures of speech and message.

chapters.title: The Sower — Victor Hugo
chapters.notes: Focus on the farmer’s hard work, hope and dignity of labour. Prepare the poem’s meaning, imagery, figures of speech, rhyme scheme and central idea.

chapters.title: There is Another Sky — Emily Dickinson
chapters.notes: Study the poem’s hopeful view of nature and the mind. Explain the imagery and contrast, and prepare a complete appreciation with theme and poetic devices.

chapters.title: Upon Westminster Bridge — William Wordsworth
chapters.notes: Revise the speaker’s admiration of London at dawn, the calm cityscape and personification/imagery. Prepare the poem’s central idea and appreciation.

chapters.title: Nose versus Eyes — William Cowper
chapters.notes: Understand the humorous dispute and its message about cooperation and resolving disagreements. Revise the characters, situation, humour and moral.

chapters.title: The Planners — Boey Kim Cheng
chapters.notes: Study urban development, planning and the loss of history and individuality. Prepare the speaker’s attitude, imagery, contrast and central theme.

chapters.title: Expansion of Ideas
chapters.notes: Format: explain the given thought, develop it with reasons/examples, and conclude with a clear message. Keep the paragraph coherent, relevant and grammatically correct.

chapters.title: Blog Writing
chapters.notes: Use a suitable title, opening paragraph, organised points and a concluding thought. Write in an engaging but appropriate tone; check facts, spelling and paragraph flow.

chapters.title: E-mails
chapters.notes: Use To, Subject, Salutation, concise body, closing and name. Keep formal emails polite and direct; use an informative subject line and proofread before sending.

chapters.title: Interview
chapters.notes: Prepare a brief introduction, relevant questions in logical order and suitable responses. Use clear question-answer formatting and maintain a respectful tone.

chapters.title: Film Review
chapters.notes: Include film title, director, main cast, genre, brief plot without revealing key twists, acting, direction, music and an overall recommendation supported by reasons.

chapters.title: The Art of Comparing
chapters.notes: A comparison should introduce both items, use common criteria, explain similarities and differences fairly, and finish with a balanced conclusion.

chapters.title: History of English Drama
chapters.notes: Revise the origin and development of English drama, major periods, important playwrights and features of tragedy, comedy and other dramatic forms.

chapters.title: The Rising of the Moon — Lady Gregory
chapters.notes: Prepare the plot, setting, character sketches, conflict, dramatic tension and theme. Pay attention to dialogue, stage directions and the ending.

chapters.title: A Midsummer Night’s Dream — William Shakespeare
chapters.notes: Study the characters, relationships, mistaken identities and comic elements in the prescribed extract. Use the textbook extract for exact events and quotations.

chapters.title: An Enemy of the People — Henrik Johan Ibsen
chapters.notes: Study the conflict between truth, public opinion and social responsibility in the prescribed extract. Revise character motives and dramatic conflict.

chapters.title: प्रेरणा
chapters.notes: पाठ का सार, मुख्य भाव और प्रेरणा देने वाले विचार लिखें। लेखक/कवि का परिचय तथा पाठ से मिलने वाली सीख दोहराएँ।

chapters.title: लघुकथाएँ — उषा की दीपावली और मुस्कुराती चोट
chapters.notes: दोनों लघुकथाओं की कथावस्तु, पात्र, घटनाक्रम और संदेश अलग-अलग समझें। तुलना करते समय दोनों कहानियों की विशेषताएँ लिखें।

chapters.title: पंद्रह अगस्त
chapters.notes: कविता का केंद्रीय भाव, स्वतंत्रता दिवस का महत्व और देशप्रेम की भावना समझें। कठिन शब्दों के अर्थ और भावार्थ का अभ्यास करें।

chapters.title: मेरा भला करने वालों से बचाएँ
chapters.notes: व्यंग्य की शैली, लेखक का दृष्टिकोण और दिखावे तथा वास्तविक भलाई के बीच अंतर समझें। सारांश और आशय आधारित प्रश्न तैयार करें।

chapters.title: मध्ययुगीन काव्य — भक्ति महिमा
chapters.notes: भक्ति-भाव, ईश्वर के प्रति समर्पण और काव्य में व्यक्त जीवन-मूल्यों का भावार्थ लिखें।

chapters.title: मध्ययुगीन काव्य — बाल लीला
chapters.notes: कविता में बाल-स्वरूप का चित्रण, वात्सल्य भाव और काव्य-सौंदर्य समझें।

chapters.title: कलम का सिपाही
chapters.notes: पाठ का सार, साहित्यकार के व्यक्तित्व और लेखन के महत्व को समझें। प्रमुख घटनाएँ और पाठ का संदेश लिखें।

chapters.title: स्वागत है!
chapters.notes: कविता का भाव, स्वागत की भावना और मानवीय संबंधों का महत्व समझें। भावार्थ तथा शब्दार्थ का अभ्यास करें।

chapters.title: तत्सत
chapters.notes: कहानी के प्रतीक, कथानक, पात्र और मूल विचार समझें। पाठ से जुड़े अर्थ-आधारित प्रश्न तैयार करें।

chapters.title: गजलें — दोस्ती और मौजूद
chapters.notes: दोनों गजलों का भावार्थ, प्रमुख विचार, भाषा-शैली और गजल की विशेषताएँ समझें।

chapters.title: महत्त्वाकांक्षा और लोभ
chapters.notes: महत्त्वाकांक्षा तथा लोभ का अंतर, उनके परिणाम और लेखक का संदेश समझें। उदाहरण सहित उत्तर लिखने का अभ्यास करें।

chapters.title: भारती का सपूत
chapters.notes: पाठ का सार, प्रमुख व्यक्तित्व, योगदान और देश/समाज के प्रति जिम्मेदारी का भाव समझें।

chapters.title: सहर्ष स्वीकारा है
chapters.notes: कविता का केंद्रीय भाव, स्वीकृति, संघर्ष और जीवन-दृष्टि समझें। भावार्थ और काव्य-सौंदर्य का अभ्यास करें।

chapters.title: नुक्कड़ नाटक — मौसम और अनमोल जिंदगी
chapters.notes: नाटक का उद्देश्य, पात्र, संवाद, मंचन और सामाजिक संदेश समझें। दोनों नाटकों के कथानक अलग-अलग लिखें।

chapters.title: हिंदी में उज्ज्वल भविष्य की संभावनाएँ
chapters.notes: हिंदी भाषा के उपयोग, शिक्षा, रोजगार और संचार में संभावनाओं पर व्यवस्थित उत्तर तैयार करें।

chapters.title: समाचार : जन से जनहित तक
chapters.notes: समाचार का उद्देश्य, तथ्यपरकता, शीर्षक, समाचार लेखन की संरचना और जनहित का महत्व समझें।

chapters.title: रेडियो जॉकी
chapters.notes: रेडियो जॉकी की भूमिका, आवाज़, प्रस्तुति, श्रोताओं से संवाद और कार्यक्रम की रूपरेखा समझें।

chapters.title: ई-अध्ययन : नई दृष्टि
chapters.notes: डिजिटल अध्ययन के लाभ, चुनौतियाँ और जिम्मेदार उपयोग समझें। उत्तर में उदाहरण और संतुलित निष्कर्ष दें।

chapters.title: हिंदी व्याकरण और रचना
chapters.notes: अपठित गद्यांश/काव्यांश, शब्द-संपदा, मुहावरे, वाक्य-शुद्धि, काल, रस और अलंकार का नियमित अभ्यास करें। निबंध, पत्र, विज्ञापन, अनुवाद, संवाद और वृत्तांत के प्रारूप दोहराएँ।

chapters.title: मामू
chapters.notes: पाठाचा आशय, व्यक्तिचित्रातील मामूंचे स्वभाववैशिष्ट्य, महत्त्वाच्या घटना आणि लेखकाचा दृष्टिकोन समजून घ्या.

chapters.title: प्राणसई
chapters.notes: कवितेचा भावार्थ, निसर्गचित्रण, प्रतिमा आणि कवयित्रीची भावना स्पष्ट करा. रसग्रहणाचा सराव करा.

chapters.title: अशी पुस्तकं
chapters.notes: पुस्तकांचे महत्त्व, वाचनसंस्कृती आणि लेखकाचे विचार समजून घ्या. आशय व मुख्य मुद्दे लिहा.

chapters.title: झाडांच्या मनात जाऊ
chapters.notes: कवितेतील निसर्गप्रेम, झाडांचे महत्त्व आणि मानवी-निसर्ग संबंध यांचा भावार्थ समजून घ्या.

chapters.title: परिमळ
chapters.notes: लेखाचा आशय, भाषाशैली आणि लेखकाने मांडलेले विचार समजून घ्या. महत्त्वाचे मुद्दे नोंदवा.

chapters.title: दवांत आलीस भल्या पहाटीं
chapters.notes: कवितेतील निसर्गसौंदर्य, प्रतिमा, भावविश्व आणि काव्यवैशिष्ट्ये समजून घ्या.

chapters.title: ‘माणूस’ बांधूया!
chapters.notes: मानवी मूल्ये, सामाजिक ऐक्य आणि माणुसकीचा संदेश समजून घ्या. उदाहरणांसह उत्तर लिहा.

chapters.title: ऐसीं अक्षरें रसिकें
chapters.notes: अभंग/संतकाव्यातील विचार, भक्तिभाव आणि भाषासौंदर्य यांचा अर्थ समजून घ्या.

chapters.title: वहिनींचा ‘सुसाट’ सल्ला
chapters.notes: कथेतील विनोद, पात्रांचे स्वभाव, प्रसंग आणि लेखकाने निर्माण केलेला परिणाम समजून घ्या.

chapters.title: शब्द
chapters.notes: कवितेतील शब्दांचे सामर्थ्य, सामाजिक आशय आणि कवीची भूमिका स्पष्ट करा.

chapters.title: वाङ्मयीन लेण्याचा शिल्पकार
chapters.notes: व्यक्तिचित्र/चरित्रपर लेखातील व्यक्तीचे योगदान, साहित्यिक कार्य आणि लेखिकेचा दृष्टिकोन समजून घ्या.

chapters.title: पैंजण
chapters.notes: कवितेचा आशय, स्त्री-अनुभव, प्रतिमा आणि काव्यसौंदर्य समजून घ्या.

chapters.title: हसवाफसवी
chapters.notes: नाटकाचा कथानक, पात्रे, विनोदी प्रसंग, संवाद आणि नाट्यवैशिष्ट्ये लिहा.

chapters.title: ध्यानीमनी
chapters.notes: नाटकातील संघर्ष, पात्रांचे विचार, प्रसंगरचना आणि शीर्षकाचे औचित्य समजून घ्या.

chapters.title: सुंदर मी होणार
chapters.notes: नाटकाचा आशय, पात्रविकास, संवाद आणि मध्यवर्ती संदेश समजून घ्या.

chapters.title: सूत्रसंचालन
chapters.notes: कार्यक्रमाची सुरुवात, पाहुण्यांची ओळख, कार्यक्रमाचे दुवे, आभार आणि समारोप यांचा योग्य क्रम शिका.

chapters.title: मुद्रितशोधन
chapters.notes: मजकुरातील शुद्धलेखन, विरामचिन्हे, व्याकरण आणि मांडणीतील चुका शोधून दुरुस्त करण्याचा सराव करा.

chapters.title: अनुवाद
chapters.notes: मूळ अर्थ, संदर्भ आणि शैली कायम ठेवून अचूक व स्वाभाविक मराठी अनुवाद करा.

chapters.title: अनुदिनी (ब्लॉग) लेखन
chapters.notes: आकर्षक शीर्षक, प्रस्तावना, मुद्देसूद परिच्छेद आणि निष्कर्ष वापरून ब्लॉग लिहा.

chapters.title: रेडिओजॉकी
chapters.notes: निवेदन, आवाजातील चढ-उतार, श्रोत्यांशी संवाद आणि कार्यक्रमाची रचना समजून घ्या.

chapters.title: शब्दशक्ती
chapters.notes: शब्दांच्या अर्थछटा आणि संदर्भानुसार अर्थ समजून घ्या; पाठ्यपुस्तकातील उदाहरणे सोडवा.

chapters.title: काव्यगुण
chapters.notes: कवितेतील आशय, माधुर्य, प्रसाद, ओज इत्यादी काव्यगुणांची ओळख उदाहरणांसह करा.

chapters.title: वाक्यसंश्लेषण
chapters.notes: दोन किंवा अधिक वाक्ये अर्थ न बदलता योग्य रचनेने एकत्र करण्याचा सराव करा.

chapters.title: काळ
chapters.notes: वर्तमान, भूत आणि भविष्यकाळ तसेच त्यांचे उपप्रकार उदाहरणांसह ओळखा.

chapters.title: काव्याचे रसग्रहण
chapters.notes: कवितेचा विषय, कवी, मध्यवर्ती कल्पना, आवडलेली ओळ, भाषासौंदर्य आणि स्वतःची प्रतिक्रिया लिहा.

chapters.title: परिशिष्ट
chapters.notes: पाठ्यपुस्तकातील परिशिष्टातील संदर्भ, शब्दसूची आणि पूरक माहिती पुनरावृत्तीसाठी वापरा.

chapters.title: Introduction to Book-Keeping and Accountancy
chapters.notes: Book-keeping is the systematic recording of financial transactions. Accountancy includes recording, classifying, summarising, analysing and interpreting financial information. Revise objectives, users and basic terms.

chapters.title: Meaning and Fundamentals of Double Entry Book-Keeping
chapters.notes: Every transaction has two aspects: debit and credit. The accounting equation is Assets = Liabilities + Capital. Revise the rules of debit and credit and the dual effect of transactions.

chapters.title: Journal
chapters.notes: The journal is the book of original entry. Record transactions chronologically with date, accounts, debit amount, credit amount and narration. Apply the rules of personal, real and nominal accounts.

chapters.title: Ledger
chapters.notes: A ledger contains individual accounts classified from journal entries. Learn posting, balancing accounts and preparing a trial balance from ledger balances.

chapters.title: Subsidiary Books
chapters.notes: Subsidiary books record similar transactions separately, such as cash book, purchases book, sales book, returns books and bills books. Understand which transactions belong in each book.

chapters.title: Bank Reconciliation Statement
chapters.notes: A Bank Reconciliation Statement explains differences between the cash book bank balance and pass book/bank statement balance. Identify timing differences, bank charges, direct deposits and errors.

chapters.title: Depreciation
chapters.notes: Depreciation is the systematic allocation of the depreciable amount of a fixed asset over its useful life. Study causes, need and methods prescribed in the textbook, with worked examples.

chapters.title: Rectification of Errors
chapters.notes: Errors may affect one or more accounts and may or may not affect the trial balance. Learn types of errors, suspense account where applicable and journal entries for correction.

chapters.title: Final Accounts of a Proprietary Concern
chapters.notes: Prepare Trading Account, Profit and Loss Account and Balance Sheet. Classify items correctly and account for adjustments such as closing stock, outstanding/prepaid expenses and depreciation.

chapters.title: Single Entry System
chapters.notes: The single entry system is an incomplete system of recording transactions. Study its features, limitations and the statement of affairs method for ascertaining profit or loss.

chapters.title: Introduction of Commerce and Business
chapters.notes: Understand human wants, economic activities, business, profession and employment. Revise characteristics, objectives and the role of commerce in connecting production and consumption.

chapters.title: Trade
chapters.notes: Trade is the buying and selling of goods and services. Study internal and international trade, wholesale and retail trade, and auxiliaries to trade such as transport, banking, insurance and warehousing.

chapters.title: Small Scale Industry and Business
chapters.notes: Study the meaning, characteristics, importance, opportunities and challenges of small-scale business. Understand its contribution to employment and regional development.

chapters.title: Forms of Business Organisation - I
chapters.notes: Compare sole trading concern and partnership on ownership, capital, liability, control, continuity and suitability. Learn the key features and limitations of each form.

chapters.title: Forms of Business Organisation - II
chapters.notes: Study joint stock companies and co-operative societies. Compare formation, ownership, liability, management, continuity and distribution of profits.

chapters.title: Institutes Supporting Business
chapters.notes: Understand how institutions support entrepreneurs and businesses through finance, training, guidance, infrastructure and marketing assistance. Learn the role of each institution in the textbook.

chapters.title: Business Environment
chapters.notes: Business environment includes internal and external forces affecting business decisions. Study economic, social, political, legal, technological and natural factors.

chapters.title: Introduction to Management
chapters.notes: Management involves planning, organising, staffing, directing and controlling resources to achieve objectives efficiently and effectively. Revise levels, importance and functions of management.

chapters.title: Secretary
chapters.notes: A secretary assists an organisation with communication, records, meetings and administrative coordination. Study qualities, duties, responsibilities and types of secretary.

chapters.title: Joint Stock Company
chapters.notes: A joint stock company is an incorporated association with separate legal identity and capital divided into shares. Revise features, merits, limitations and types.

chapters.title: Formation of a Company
chapters.notes: Study the stages of company formation: promotion, incorporation, capital subscription and commencement of business, as applicable to the prescribed company type.

chapters.title: Documents related to formation of a company
chapters.notes: Understand the purpose and contents of the Memorandum of Association, Articles of Association, prospectus and other prescribed formation documents.

chapters.title: Members of a company
chapters.notes: Study who can become a member, modes of membership, rights, duties and termination of membership. Distinguish a member from a shareholder where relevant.

chapters.title: Directors and Key Managerial Personnel of a company
chapters.notes: Revise the role, appointment, qualifications, powers, duties and responsibilities of directors and key managerial personnel under the prescribed syllabus.

chapters.title: Company Meetings - I
chapters.notes: Study the meaning, importance, types and procedures of company meetings. Understand notice, agenda, quorum and chairperson.

chapters.title: Company Meetings - II
chapters.notes: Revise resolutions, minutes, voting methods and the procedural requirements associated with company meetings.

chapters.title: Business Communication Skills of Secretary
chapters.notes: A secretary needs clear written, oral and digital communication. Study listening, speaking, drafting, etiquette and professional correspondence.

chapters.title: Correspondence with Directors
chapters.notes: Practise formal letters/emails to directors using correct layout, subject, respectful language, clear purpose and concise supporting details.

chapters.title: Correspondence with Banks
chapters.notes: Study common business letters to banks, including requests for information, statements, services and account-related communication. Follow the prescribed format.

chapters.title: Correspondence with Statutory Authorities
chapters.notes: Learn formal correspondence with government and regulatory authorities. Use accurate references, dates, enclosures and a clear, courteous request.

chapters.title: BASIC CONCEPTS IN ECONOMICS
chapters.notes: Economics studies how people and societies use scarce resources to satisfy unlimited wants. Revise scarcity, choice, opportunity cost, utility, demand, supply and basic economic problems.

chapters.title: MONEY
chapters.notes: Money is generally accepted as a medium of exchange and performs functions such as measure of value, store of value and standard of deferred payment. Study forms and role of money.

chapters.title: PARTITION VALUES
chapters.notes: Study the statistical measures and concepts prescribed under this chapter. Learn definitions, classification, formulae and worked examples directly from the textbook; practise each numerical step.

chapters.title: THE ECONOMY OF MAHARASHTRA
chapters.notes: Study the structure and important features of Maharashtra’s economy, including agriculture, industry and services. Use textbook data and distinguish facts from general observations.

chapters.title: RURAL DEVELOPMENT IN INDIA
chapters.notes: Rural development aims to improve living standards and opportunities in rural areas. Study rural infrastructure, credit, employment, agriculture and development programmes mentioned in the text.

chapters.title: POPULATION IN INDIA
chapters.notes: Revise population size, distribution, density, growth, composition and demographic indicators. Understand how population characteristics affect development and public services.

chapters.title: UNEMPLOYMENT IN INDIA
chapters.notes: Unemployment occurs when people willing and able to work cannot find suitable work. Study types, causes, effects and measures to reduce unemployment.

chapters.title: POVERTY IN INDIA
chapters.notes: Poverty refers to deprivation of basic needs and opportunities. Study causes, consequences, measurement concepts and poverty alleviation measures in the textbook.

chapters.title: ECONOMIC POLICY OF INDIA SINCE 1991
chapters.notes: Study the background and broad features of liberalisation, privatisation and globalisation (LPG), along with their objectives, benefits and challenges.

chapters.title: ECONOMIC PLANNING IN INDIA
chapters.notes: Understand the objectives, importance and broad evolution of economic planning in India. Revise planning institutions and the shift in policy approach described in the textbook.

chapters.title: Basics of Information Technology
chapters.notes: Study data and information, computer systems, hardware, software, input/output devices, storage, networks and safe digital practices. Learn key terms and basic applications.

chapters.title: Introduction to DBMS
chapters.notes: A Database Management System stores, organises and retrieves data. Revise tables, records, fields, keys, relationships and the advantages of database management.

chapters.title: Impressive Web Designing
chapters.notes: Study the structure of web pages, HTML elements, attributes, links, images, lists, tables and basic page design. Practise the examples from the textbook.

chapters.title: Cyber Law
chapters.notes: Cyber law governs activities involving computers, networks and digital information. Study digital rights, responsibilities, cyber safety, privacy and the legal concepts in the textbook.

chapters.title: SOP: Daily Computing (LibreOffice)
chapters.notes: Practise creating, editing, formatting and saving documents and spreadsheets using the prescribed LibreOffice applications. Follow the practical steps in the textbook.

chapters.title: SOP: Web Designing (HTML-5)
chapters.notes: Practise the basic HTML document structure and common elements using the textbook examples. Understand tags, attributes and page organisation.

chapters.title: SOP: Client Side Scripting (JavaScript)
chapters.notes: Study the role of client-side scripting and practise the introductory JavaScript examples provided in the textbook.

chapters.title: SOP: Accounting Package (GNUKhata)
chapters.notes: Understand the purpose of accounting software and practise the prescribed basic tasks using the textbook’s guided activities.

chapters.title: SOP: Digital Content Creation (GIMP, Inkscape)
chapters.notes: Study the basic purpose of raster and vector graphics tools and practise the textbook’s image-editing and illustration activities.

chapters.title: SOP: DBMS (PostgreSQL)
chapters.notes: Understand the database environment and practise the SQL/database tasks specifically listed in the textbook practical section.

chapters.title: Appendix: Installation and Abbreviations
chapters.notes: Use the appendix as a reference for the prescribed installation steps and technical abbreviations. Follow only the textbook’s supported setup instructions.

chapters.title: Development of Physical Fitness
chapters.notes: Study the components of physical fitness, their importance and safe ways to develop them. Understand that fitness activities should be suitable for age and ability.

chapters.title: Obesity
chapters.notes: Study the meaning, contributing factors, health effects and prevention of obesity. Focus on balanced habits, wellbeing and evidence-based health information; avoid stigma.

chapters.title: Nature and Diet
chapters.notes: Understand the relationship between nutrition, hydration and physical activity. Study balanced diet, nutrients and the role of food groups.

chapters.title: Yoga and Mudra
chapters.notes: Study the meaning, principles and general benefits of yoga and mudras. Follow age-appropriate, comfortable practice and seek qualified supervision for physical techniques.

chapters.title: Doping (Stimulants)
chapters.notes: Learn the meaning of doping, why it is prohibited in sport, health and fairness concerns, and the role of anti-doping education. This chapter is for awareness, not instructions for using substances.

chapters.title: Injury Management
chapters.notes: Study common sports injuries, prevention, basic first-aid principles and the importance of getting help from a qualified adult or medical professional.

chapters.title: Modern Technology - Activism
chapters.notes: Study how modern technology supports sports training, performance analysis, officiating, communication and sports promotion. Consider benefits and limitations.

chapters.title: Career Opportunities in Sports
chapters.notes: Explore career areas such as coaching, physical education, sports management, officiating, fitness education and sports media. Study the qualifications described in the textbook.

chapters.title: Various Games
chapters.notes: Revise the games included in the textbook, their history, basic rules, playing area, equipment and skills. Use the textbook for exact dimensions and regulations.

chapters.title: Various Sports Competitions
chapters.notes: Study the types, organisation and importance of sports competitions, tournaments, fixtures, sportsmanship and fair play.

chapters.title: Success Stories of Sportsmen
chapters.notes: Use the examples in the textbook to identify qualities such as discipline, perseverance, teamwork and responsible conduct.

chapters.title: Practical Work
chapters.notes: Complete the practical activities and records prescribed by the school/college teacher. Record observations accurately.

chapters.title: Environment and Sustainable Development
chapters.notes: Understand the meaning and components of environment, human-environment relationships and sustainable development. Study the balance between present needs and future generations.

chapters.title: Ecosystems
chapters.notes: An ecosystem includes living organisms and their non-living surroundings interacting with one another. Revise biotic and abiotic components, food chains, food webs and energy flow.

chapters.title: Biodiversity
chapters.notes: Biodiversity is the variety of life at genetic, species and ecosystem levels. Study its importance, threats, conservation and examples from India.

chapters.title: Natural Resources
chapters.notes: Study renewable and non-renewable resources, their uses, conservation and sustainable management. Consider water, forests, land, minerals and energy resources.

chapters.title: Disasters
chapters.notes: Study natural and human-made disasters, their impacts, preparedness, mitigation and community response. Focus on awareness and following official safety guidance.

chapters.title: Glossary
chapters.notes: Revise important environmental terms and their textbook definitions. Make a personal list of difficult terms with short meanings.

chapters.title: Project Guidelines and List
chapters.notes: Choose a project from the textbook/school list, define its objective, collect reliable information, organise observations and present a clear conclusion.
